svg.title: Evidence-to-dossier flow
svg.desc: A host-owned source adapter normalizes public or entitled evidence through a provider-neutral SourcePort boundary. The host derives portable terminal lineage fields from retained batches, while sanitized failed attempts and coverage gaps remain host receipts that must be declared as limitations when decision-relevant. Portable validates provenance, time, licensing, claims, and calculations before a completed dossier is atomically published; a rejected terminal submission is not published.
